name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: A panel that slides in from the edge for a task that needs more room than a dialog.

Both are bg/card with a * border/subtle edge on the open side and the shadcn `lg` shadow, 16px in and 16px between a * header (14px medium title over a 13px muted description, 2px apart), the content and a * right-aligned footer of buttons 8px apart (on the bottom sheet they share the width). * * Built on the Radix Dialog: focus moves in on open and back to the trigger on close; Escape, * the backdrop or the handle closes it.
